# Library Lending Portal — Business Requirements (synthetic test fixture)

## 1. Overview
The Library Lending Portal lets members borrow and return books online.
The goal is to reduce desk queues and give staff accurate stock levels.

## 2. Membership
### 2.1 Registration
A visitor shall register with a valid email address and a password to become a member.
The system must send a confirmation email after registration.

### 2.2 Borrowing limits
A member may borrow at most 5 books at the same time.
Borrowed books must be returned within 14 days.

## 3. Lending
### 3.1 Borrowing a book
A member shall be able to borrow an available book from the catalogue.
The system must record the borrow date and due date.

### 3.2 Late returns
A member who returns a book late shall be charged a fine. The fine rate is to be decided.

## 4. Reporting
The system should provide staff a report of overdue books.

## 5. Non-functional
Pages must load quickly for members on mobile devices.
